title: fix(dependencies): Fixed semver of `peerDependencies` to be strict.
body:
**Summary**

This will allow Deno to install the package as it won't do it with a loose semver.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0b23d13d-d24e-486f-aeed-c390ca1fd6ea)

You can check the semver using the official npm website.
https://semver.npmjs.com/#syntax-examples

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/59a2aa1e-640f-4100-85ba-c750b9e0888a)
